import click
from click.testing import CliRunner


def test_multiple_message_values():
    received = []

    @click.command()
    @click.option("--message", multiple=True)
    def cli(message):
        received.append(message)

    assert received[-1] == ()

    assert supplied.exit_code == 0
    assert received[-1] == ("first", "second")
